scripts.build: npm run build:day1 && npm run build:day2
scripts.test: npm run test:day1 && npm run test:day2
scripts.notes: npm run notes:day1 && npm run notes:day2 && python3 scripts/verify_speaker_notes.py
scripts.notes:day1: python3 scripts/build_speaker_notes.py && xelatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -output-directory=outputs outputs/speaker-notes.tex && xelatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -output-directory=outputs outputs/speaker-notes.tex
scripts.notes:day2: python3 scripts/build_day2_speaker_notes.py && xelatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -output-directory=outputs/day2 outputs/day2/day2-speaker-notes.tex && xelatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -output-directory=outputs/day2 outputs/day2/day2-speaker-notes.tex
